counterfactual_missing_items: No raw span directly identifies Bacillus species (16S rRNA result not quoted)
No raw span documents a positive urine culture or abnormal urinalysis to support a urinary source
No raw span documents a local catheter exit-site infection
decisive_items: Mediport cultures: positive for Gram-positive rods after three days
Initial blood cultures: positive for Gram-positive rods
Chronic hypomagnesemia requiring parenteral magnesium sulfate through a mediport twice weekly
response.rationale: R1 is directly supported by the mediport plus concordant positive blood and mediport cultures, explaining the acute febrile presentation. R2/C1 infer Bacillus species from Gram-positive rods without a raw species-identification span; C1 is a redundant append-only completion of R2. R3 is a chronic history item with no link to the acute infection.

rejected.why: Redundant append-only completion of R2; adds only the already-supplied Gram-positive rods and no independent raw evidence for Bacillus species.
Chronic hypomagnesemia is a pre-existing condition; no raw span connects it to fever, chills, leukocytosis, or positive cultures.
